verdict.rationale: Pulley's fundraising-modeling docs mention running models for 'complex pre-financing, post-financing, or exit scenarios' and pro-formas for priced rounds/SAFEs, implying some exit modeling capability, but there is no specific evidence of a waterfall analysis showing per-share-class/stakeholder proceeds honoring liquidation preferences and participation rights. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a waterfall model breaking down proceeds by share class/stakeholder, preference stacking, participation rights handling, and any independent/hands-on validation.
